question.text: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)
question.resolution_criteria:
Each subquestion will resolve as the revenue reported in each company's first official quarterly earnings release after September 30, 2026. This is expected to be released no earlier than:

* Apple Q4 FY2026 November 2, 2026 ([source](https://finance.yahoo.com/calendar/earnings?symbol=AAPL))
* AMD Q3 FY2026 November 3, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AMD/earnings))
* Amazon Q3 FY2026 October 29, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AMZN/earnings))
* Meta Q3 FY2026 October 21, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/META/earnings))
* Microsoft Q1 FY 2027 October 28, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/MSFT/earnings))
* Nvidia Q3 FY 2027 November 25, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/NVDA/earnings))
* SpaceX Q3 FY 2026 October 20, 2026 ([source](https://www.wallstreethorizon.com/spacex-earnings-calendar))
* Tesla Q3 FY 2026 October 21, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/TSLA/earnings))

The earnings reports are typically released on the respective companies' investor relations websites and filed with the [U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)](https://www.sec.gov/search-filings) as a Form 8-K.
question.fine_print:
Only the initially reported figures encompassing the entirety of the previous quarter will be considered. Any subsequent revisions, corrections, or restatements will not affect resolution. 

If a company does not publicly report earnings after September 30, 2026 and before January 1, 2027 or if it ceases to operate as a standalone public company, that specific subquestion will be **annulled**.

## Nvidia Q3 FY2027 revenue: research brief (as of 2026-10-28)

Nvidia has not reported yet. Its official guidance is $108.0B ±2% (about $105.8B to $110.2B). Over the last six quarters it has always beaten its own guidance, by 2.5% to 5.7%.

### 1. Resolution source
- The figure that counts is GAAP total revenue in Nvidia's Q3 FY2027 earnings release, for the quarter ending around late October 2026. It will be posted on investor.nvidia.com and filed as an 8-K exhibit.
- 2026-08-26: The latest release was Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended 2026-07-26). Revenue was $96.2B, up 106% year over year and 18% from the prior quarter. Data Center revenue was $89.0B. Q3 outlook: "$108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%", assuming no Data Center compute revenue from China. Gross margin guided to 74.0% ±50 bp, GAAP opex about $9.2B. [Nvidia newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2027), [SEC 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000073/q2fy27pr.htm)
- The release does not give a Q3 report date.

### 2. Current status
- Nothing is settled yet.
- Report date: I could not find an official notice. Trackers and markets point to Wednesday 2026-11-18 after the close (MarketBeat, Manifold, Kalshi). One site says 11-17, and one tracker lists 11-17, 11-18 or 11-25 as possible. [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-11-18-nvidia-co-stock/), [earningscountdown](https://earningscountdown.com/stock/nvda/)
- This is earlier than the 11-25 date in the question text. It doesn't change anything, because the question resolves on the first release after Sep 30.
- Last year the "Sets Conference Call" notice came out on 2025-10-29, for a 2025-11-19 report. A similar notice could come out any day now. [Nvidia IR 2025](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2025/NVIDIA-Sets-Conference-Call-for-Third-Quarter-Financial-Results/)

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-27: Reports say Nvidia confirmed a $3B investment in Meta, and Meta plans to expand its use of Vera Rubin systems (Invezz; I have not checked this against a primary source). [Invezz](https://invezz.com/de/news/2026/10/27/nasdaq-futures-legen-140-punkte-zu-5-dinge-vor-handelsstart-an-der-wall-street/)
- 2026-10-27: Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon report on Oct 28-29. Their capex commentary is the main read-through for Nvidia demand. [Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/10/27/big-tech-is-about-to-report-nvidia-investors-should-watch-one-number/)
- 2026-10-26: Jensen Huang said Vera Rubin brings in about $40B of revenue per gigawatt, versus about $25B for Grace Blackwell. [AOL](https://www.aol.com/articles/jensen-huang-says-nvidias-next-042000000.html)
- 2026-10-25/26: Musk said SpaceX secured $40B of debt financing to spend on Nvidia GPUs. He also warned that some neoclouds could fail. [Epoch Times](https://www.epochtimes.com/b5/26/10/26/n14876921.htm)
- 2026-10-26: Le Journal du Net reports that investors are losing confidence in debt issued by AI infrastructure firms and neoclouds. [JDN](https://www.journaldunet.com/business/1556959-assiste-t-on-vraiment-aux-premices-d-un-krach-de-l-ia/)
- 2026-08-26: Nvidia projected about 70% revenue growth for FY2028. Analysts had expected about 44%. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/26/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q2-2027-live-updates.html), [S&P Global](https://www.spglobal.com/market-intelligence/en/news-insights/research/2026/09/nvidia-postq-growth-outlook-resets-expectations-well-above-preq-consensus)

### 4. Base rates
Actual revenue versus the midpoint of Nvidia's own guidance (from figures I remember for FY26, and search results for FY27):

| Quarter | Guidance | Actual | Beat |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 FY26 | $43.0B | $44.06B | +2.5% (H20 China charge) |
| Q2 FY26 | $45.0B | $46.74B | +3.9% |
| Q3 FY26 | $54.0B | $57.01B | +5.6% |
| Q4 FY26 | $65.0B | $68.13B | +4.8% |
| Q1 FY27 | $78.0B | $81.6B | +4.6% ([Vested](https://vestedfinance.com/blog/us-stocks/nvidia-q1-fy27-earnings-a-closer-read-of-a-record-quarter/)) |
| Q2 FY27 | $91.0B | $96.2B | +5.7% |

- In recent quarters Nvidia has always landed above the top of its ±2% guidance range.
- Applying the historical beat range (+2.5% to +5.7%) to $108B gives about $110.7B to $114.2B.
- Quarter-over-quarter growth over the last four quarters: +22%, +19.5%, +19.8%, +17.9%. Repeating +18% to +20% on $96.2B gives about $113.5B to $115.5B. Guidance alone implies +12.2%.

### 5. Other forecasts
- Sell-side consensus: about $108.7B to $108.8B (TradingView, 2026-09-24, and another tracker), with one figure of $111.36B (MarketBeat). Before Q2, consensus was about $104.2B to $105.4B. [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-11-18-nvidia-co-stock/), [chartmill](https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/NVDA/estimates)
- Manifold, on this exact metric (GAAP total revenue): under $110B 8%; $110-112B 40%; $112-114B 26%; $114-116B 17%; $116B or more 10%. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/what-will-nvidias-q3-fiscal-2027-re)
- Polymarket, on Q3 Data Center revenue (a related metric, not total revenue): above $100B 0.80; above $105B 0.27; above $110B 0.20.
  - The $110B and $115B rungs are both priced at 0.20, the same as each other, which suggests the market is thin.
  - Data Center was about 92.5% of revenue in Q2. On that share, $105B of Data Center would mean about $113.5B total.
- Kalshi's Nvidia markets cover what will be said on the earnings call (dated Nov 18) and headcount, not revenue.
- Analysts: Gabelli expects "beat-and-raise at a minimum", and Morningstar expects a comfortable beat. [Webull](https://www.webull.com/blog/304-Nvidia-Q2-FY2027-Earnings-Beats-Revenue-EPS-Estimates-Guides-Q3-to-108B)

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-10-28/29: Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta earnings and capex guidance.
- Around late October: Nvidia's notice setting the call date.
- 2026-11-03: AMD earnings, a read on the competitive AI GPU market.
- Any change on China export licenses: guidance assumes no China Data Center compute revenue, so approval would be upside.
- Also: Vera Rubin ramp timing, supply constraints at TSMC (CoWoS packaging and HBM memory), and stress in neocloud credit markets.
- Around 2026-11-17/18: the report itself, before forecasts close on 11-25.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** Nvidia is expected to report around November 18, 2026 (trackers say Nov 17-25). That is about 3 to 4 weeks away.

(b) **Latest known value:** Q2 FY2027 revenue (quarter ended July 26, 2026) was $96,221 million, reported August 26, 2026. Q3 guidance is $108.0B ±2%.

(c) **If nothing changed:** Revenue would land at the guidance midpoint, $108.0B.

(d) **If the trend continued:**
- Nvidia has beaten the midpoint of its own guidance by 4.6% to 5.7% in each of the last four quarters. Applying that to $108B gives roughly $113-114B.
- Repeating the recent 18-20% quarter-over-quarter growth gives $113.5-115.5B.

(e) **Historical variation:**
- Beats over the last six quarters ranged from +2.5% to +5.7%, which is about $2.7B to $6.2B on this base.
- Every recent quarter came in above the top of the ±2% guidance range ($110.2B).

(f) **Expert and market expectations:**
- Sell-side consensus is about $108.7-108.8B, with one figure of $111.4B. Consensus is typically conservative and close to guidance.
- Manifold's median is about $112.3B on this exact metric, with 8% below $110B and 10% at $116B or more.
- Polymarket's Data Center rungs point to roughly $100-105B of Data Center revenue. That implies about $108-113.5B total, but the market is thin.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** Supply constraints in CoWoS packaging or HBM memory, a slower Vera Rubin transition, or neocloud credit stress delaying shipments. Any of these could push revenue to the guidance midpoint or below, around $106-109B.
- **High:** China export licenses approved (guidance assumes no China revenue) plus a fast Rubin ramp. This could produce a beat of 8% or more, above $117B.

My median sits near $112.8B, between the trend-based estimate and Manifold's median. I've widened the tails to allow for unknowns.
